key_points: Routine ETF rebalancing (selling NVDA/AAPL) is mechanical, not fundamental
Daily market commentary on oil/tech moves is short-term noise
Bearish AI-bust opinion piece (TS Lombard) is speculative, not new data
No earnings, guidance, regulatory, or M&A events for SPY or major constituents
Broad-market ETF headlines rarely change long-term thesis
